# nd_multi_cluster_connectivity (Data Source)

Datasource of the ND cluster for Multi-Cluster Connectivity in Nexus Dashboard

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_multi_cluster_connectivity" "test_resource_multi_cluster_connectivity_1" {
  cluster_name = "nd4x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name that uniquely identifies the ND cluster datasource.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The IP address or Hostname of the ND cluster.
